fields.help: python runs the code with the system python3 (or MONOAGENT_PYTHON) with n8n's Python names: _items in all-items mode or _item per item; also _input.all()/first()/last() and _json and _('Node Name').all(). Return a list of dicts (or one dict per item).
fields.label: Language

fields.help: Python only: run once with all items or once per item.
fields.label: Mode

fields.help: Return an array of objects. Each object becomes an output item. Access input via $input.all() or $json (first item) and another node's output via $('Node Name').all(). A top-level return or await runs the code as an async function.
fields.label: Code

outputs.description: the fields of the items the code returns
